name: Calendar (macOS Calendar, with iCloud Calendar on the web)
summary: Apple's calendar app, with iCloud Calendar on the web.

flows.title: Create an event
steps: Go to icloud.com/calendar, signed in to your Apple Account.
Select the New Event button in the top-right corner, or on a computer double-click the time and date of the event.
Type a name and location for the event, and set any other details.

flows.title: Create a calendar
steps: Select the Add icon at the top of the sidebar, next to Calendar.
Type a name for the calendar, then press Return or Enter.

flows.title: Share a calendar with people
steps: Hold the pointer over the calendar in the sidebar, then select the Calendar Information button.
In Sharing With, select the Add button, type the invitee's email address, then press Return or Enter.
Select the Options button and choose access: Allow editing, or Read-Only.
When finished, select Done, then Save.
